description: This file defines the RandomPlacementDirector class which implements the IPlacementDirector interface for Orleans runtime. It handles the logic for randomly selecting a silo for placing activation instances, with support for placement hints.

classes.name: RandomPlacementDirector
classes.description: An internal class that implements the IPlacementDirector interface, responsible for placing activations randomly across silos within the Orleans runtime.

methods.name: OnAddActivation
methods.description: Handles the placement of a new activation by selecting a compatible silo, optionally using a placement hint if provided, otherwise selecting randomly.
